name: gsc-mcp-remote
description: Multi-property Google Search Console MCP server, local or remote. 33 SEO analysis tools — quick wins, traffic drops, content decay, cannibalisation, CTR opportunities, multi-site dashboards, a full image-search suite, and generative-AI conversation-query detection — where every property-scoped tool accepts a site_url, so one server covers a whole Search Console account. Runs over stdio or as a hosted HTTP service. OAuth and service account support.

scripts.test: node scripts/check-tools.mjs && node scripts/check-http.mjs && node scripts/check-oauth.mjs && node scripts/check-hardening.mjs

author: Oleksii Khoroshun
